dominance_rules.trigger: an expansion opportunity at an account with open breaches, complaints, or interventions
dominance_rules.action: hold the pitch until the register shows the account healthy; stabilize first

dominance_rules.rule: Disclosed mechanism dominates invented figures in every price, credit, and uptime statement
dominance_rules.rationale: the business's honesty rules forbid asserting universal numbers that are actually per-contract mechanisms
dominance_rules.trigger: any statement of price, credit amount, or availability level
dominance_rules.action: state the mechanism and the per-contract terms, or the measured figure with its method - never an invented number

dominance_rules.rule: Change control dominates convenience for all non-emergency work, and emergencies must backfill
dominance_rules.rationale: the change record is the fastest triage tool and the drift audit's ground truth; unlogged changes poison both
dominance_rules.trigger: any configuration change, urgent or routine
dominance_rules.action: log routine changes before execution; execute emergencies immediately and backfill the record within the defined window

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the handoff package and capture the baseline before writing any alert policy
anti_rework_rules.prevents: thresholds tuned against guesses that must all be re-derived once the real baseline exists

anti_rework_rules.rule: Draw and get acknowledgment on the demarc map before signing any SLA
anti_rework_rules.prevents: breach disputes over ISP and power failures the provider never owned, and the credit fights that follow

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tune deduplication and flap suppression before adding the fleet's remaining sites to paging
anti_rework_rules.prevents: alert fatigue burning out the on-call and burying the one real page a noisy month contains

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the measurement method before promising any availability figure
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unverifiable SLA claims and the retroactive method arguments that read as bad faith at claim time

anti_rework_rules.rule: Establish change authority and rogue-device alerting before any third party gets site access
anti_rework_rules.prevents: weeks of drift archaeology after a vendor's undocumented device breaks segmentation

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the canary ring to cover every hardware generation before the first fleet rollout
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a revision-specific defect bricking the exact devices the canaries never represented

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record per-site cost-to-serve continuously, not retrospectively at renewal week
anti_rework_rules.prevents: renewal pricing rebuilt from memory and a noisy site's re-price argument arriving without its evidence

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle every open breach - notice, remedy, root-cause fix - before opening the renewal conversation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: renewals collapsing into grievance sessions and discounts given to buy back trust the remedy should have kept

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pass the account-health gates before drafting any expansion or adjacent-service proposal
anti_rework_rules.prevents: cross-sell effort wasted on - and accelerating - exactly the churn it was meant to outrun

iteration_protocol.trigger: repeated false, missed, or flapping pages from a site
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive thresholds from the current baseline, adjust suppression, and fix the physical cause where one exists

iteration_protocol.trigger: a measured SLA breach or near-miss
iteration_protocol.action: notify proactively, apply the remedy, and convert the root cause into retuned alerts and calendar work

iteration_protocol.trigger: a vulnerability disclosure affecting deployed hardware
iteration_protocol.action: assess fleet exposure, choose emergency versus scheduled path, mitigate interim, notify plainly, backfill the change record

iteration_protocol.trigger: a churn signal fires - unread reports, competitor bundling, ownership rumor, post-incident silence
iteration_protocol.action: run the mapped intervention with an owner and date, and re-anchor value with the account's own incident history

iteration_protocol.trigger: a monitoring blind spot is discovered - vendor cloud outage, dead probe host, uncovered window
iteration_protocol.action: add an independent check for the gap class and restate any affected reports with the window marked unknown

iteration_protocol.trigger: a venue ownership change is detected at any account
iteration_protocol.action: run the transition path - contract status, data separation, equipment title, buyer re-onboarding as fresh intake

iteration_protocol.trigger: a sustained complaint or degradation pattern with no device fault - interference, capacity growth
iteration_protocol.action: re-optimize within the existing design against baseline evidence, and open a re-survey engagement if the design no longer fits

iteration_protocol.trigger: a site's cost-to-serve trend crosses its tier's viability line
iteration_protocol.action: classify the cause, remediate or trigger a scope correction now, and prepare the evidence-based re-price for renewal

priority_rationale: The frame nodes - intake with its baseline, the privacy boundary, and the demarc map - come first because every alert threshold, SLA clause, and support commitment downstream is judged against what they fixed; monitoring and alerting must exist before triage, maintenance, and firmware programs can operate on their signals; the SLA cluster builds on monitoring and the demarc map because a promise without a measurement method is a deferred dispute; support tiers and escalation paths operationalize the commitments; and the retention and growth nodes come last because reports, churn watch, renewals, transitions, and expansion all consume the evidence the operating layers generate.
